title: March Madness Feature Store
description: Compact, inference-ready feature vectors keyed by TeamID. This artifact is optimized for bracket prediction and model-aware comparisons in the browser.

season.description: Season represented by this feature store.

feature_set.description: Named feature set, for example `base_2026`, referenced by the model manifest and the website.

feature_order.description: Ordered list of feature keys. This is the canonical vector order for runtime inference.

teams.description: Map from TeamID string to a compact feature object. Keys are strings so they serialize cleanly as JSON object properties.

teamFeatureVector.title: Team Feature Vector
teamFeatureVector.description: Named feature values for a single team-season. All values are numeric so they can be converted to vectors without further parsing.
